title: Siman 277
section: The Greatness and Awesomeness of His Attainments

segments.en: (37.) And it is already explained [above #6] that he was particular about the great ones who were unwilling to take to heart the decrees that were heard against Israel, G-d forbid, and who said that certainly G-d would not do this. And he o.b.m. said they err greatly in this — for have we not already seen that there were many troubles and decrees against Israel? May Hashem Yisburach guard us from now on. And he o.b.m. was very afraid of them, and spoke much about them and engaged very much with all his strength and with messeeras nefesh [self-sacrifice] to sweeten and nullify them.
